Early voting for the December 12, 2026 Election begins Saturday, November 28! 🗳️🇺🇸 

With THREE early voting locations across Iberville Parish, including our East and North Iberville satellite locations established under the Daigle Administration, we're making it easier for residents to get out and vote!
 
📍 Plaquemine – Registrar of Voters Office
November 28 – December 5 (excluding Sunday)
📍 St. Gabriel – Community Center
November 28 & 30
📍 Rosedale – North Iberville Community Center
December 4 & 5
⏰ All locations will be open from 8:30 AM – 6 PM on their scheduled dates.

Whether you're voting close to home or getting it done ahead of Election Day, every vote matters! Check the schedule below, find your location, and make your voice heard! 🇺🇸 #IbervilleProud #MyIberville #EarlyVoting
